SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. .........
S. 1, Special Branches/division,
REPORT
Date September 26, 1939.

Subject... Communication dated 18-9-39 from the Netherlands Consulate-General
.........concerning Mr. L. Fisman.
Made by. D.S.I. Prokofiev    Forwarded by R. W. Mac Cu □

Leonard Onisim FISMAN (FISHMAN), former
Russian of Jewish origin, born on April 16, 1919 at
Manchouli, Manchuria. According to his own statement,
his father, Onisim Fishman, who died in Mongolia in
1923, was born at Soroka, Bessarabia, which formerly
belonged to Russia and since 1920 forms a part of
Rumania. Hence his claim to the Rumanian nationality,
although he never was in Rumania and does not speak
the Rumanian language.

He is reported to have arrived in Shanghai
from Tientsin about two months ago. When registering
with the local Rumanian Association he stated that
prior to his coming to Shanghai he resided together
with his mother in Tientsin for 16 years, his last
known address in that city being 34/6 Dublin Road.
Upon graduating from a local grammar school he attended
a business college for a period and in 1938-1939 is
reported to have been employed with Y. Wutaka & Company,
Coal Dealers, 54 Via Firenze, I.C., Tientsin.

From various documents available at the
local Rumanian Association it appears that Fishman has,
since 1936, been in correspondence with the Royal
Rumanian Legation in Japan, as well as with his
relatives in Rumania with a view to the establishing
his claim to the Rumanian nationality. It also appears
that it is by no means certain that he will be
successful in this.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。档案号 .........
S. 1，特科/组，
报告
日期：1939年9月26日。

事由……荷兰总领事馆1939年9月18日来函
……关于L. Fisman先生。
撰写人：侦探副督察 Prokofiev    转呈人：R. W. Mac Cu □

Leonard Onisim FISMAN（亦作FISHMAN），前俄籍犹太人，1919年4月16日出生于满洲里（Manchouli），满洲。据其自述，其父Onisim Fishman于1923年在蒙古去世，出生于比萨拉比亚的索罗卡（Soroka），该地原属俄国，自1920年起成为罗马尼亚的一部分。因此他声称拥有罗马尼亚国籍，尽管他从未去过罗马尼亚，也不会说罗马尼亚语。

据报，他约于两个月前从天津抵达上海。在向当地罗马尼亚协会登记时，他表示在来上海之前，他与母亲在天津居住了16年，他在该市已知的最后地址为都柏林路（Dublin Road）34/6号。从当地一所文法学校毕业后，他曾就读于一所商业学院一段时间，据报在1938-1939年间受雇于天津意租界佛罗伦萨路（Via Firenze）54号的Y. Wutaka & Company煤炭商行。

从当地罗马尼亚协会掌握的各种文件来看，Fishman自1936年以来一直与驻日本罗马尼亚公使馆以及他在罗马尼亚的亲属通信，以期确立其罗马尼亚国籍的主张。看来他能否成功于此尚不确定。

Consulaat-Generaal der Nederlanden voor Midden-China

Tel. Adr. "Hollandia"
Telefoon: 801356
No.2629.

Shanghai, 18 September 1939.
94, rue de France

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Mr. LEONARD FISMAN
has applied to this Consulate-General for a visé for admis-
sion into the Netherlands Indies.

Fisman is in possession of a Certificate of Nationality
No.107 issued by the Roumanian Association at Shanghai.

He was born at Lanchouli on April 16, 1919.

During the last 14 years he has been residing in
Tientsin where he was connected with the Ta Tung Mining
Corporation and since 1½ month he resides in Shanghai at
No.10 Route de Grouchy.

He has applied for a passport at Tokyo and intends
to visit the Netherlands Indies for one month for business
purposes (piece goods).

According to his statement he disposes of C$ 8000.--.

I should be obliged to you if you would let me know,
if possible, whether anything is known against this person
from a political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Vice-Consul
for Consul-General.

To the Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

D.S.J. Boskofio.
19/9.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆

电报挂号：“Hollandia”
电话：801356
第2629号。

上海，1939年9月18日。
法租界法兰西路94号

先生：

谨此通知您，LEONARD FISMAN先生已向本总领事馆申请前往荷属东印度群岛的签证。

Fisman持有上海罗马尼亚协会签发的第107号国籍证明书。

他于1919年4月16日出生于兰州（Lanchouli）[注：原文如此，疑为满洲里之误]。

在过去14年中，他一直居住在天津，并与大同矿业公司（Ta Tung Mining Corporation）有联系；近一个半月来，他居住在上海格罗希路（Route de Grouchy）10号。

他已在东京申请护照，打算因商务目的（匹头货物）前往荷属东印度群岛一个月。

据其陈述，他拥有法币8000元。

如蒙告知，从政治或道德角度是否有任何对此人不利的记录，我将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼

您的恭顺仆人，

副总领事
代总领事

致上海公共租界工部局警务处
特科副 commissioner，
上海。

D.S.J. Boskofio.
19/9.
